controls: Measured scenarios must remain bounded regional synthetic observations with at least three repetitions.
Throughput must be arithmetically consistent with records and each scenario's elapsed time.
Unknown resource and cost measurements must remain explicitly null with non-measured statuses.
Projection arithmetic must match the regional baseline and declared scaling factor.
Archive-only and disabled-domain markers are required for ingestion and accessibility.
National output must remain an explicit linear projection, never a measurement.
Archive-only ingestion and reference-only accessibility boundaries are fail-closed.
non_claims: This validator does not create national-scale, hosted, operational or release evidence.
Resource and cost nulls remain unknown rather than being inferred.
